name: Life Insurance Corporation of India
about: Life Insurance Corporation of India provides life insurance products in India, Fiji, Mauritius, and the United Kingdom. The company offers insurance plans, including endowment, whole life, term insurance, money back, and term assurance plans, as well as riders comprising accidental death and disability benefit, critical illness benefit, and premium waiver benefit riders. It also provides pension, unit linked, micro insurance, withdrawn, and health plans, as well as various group schemes. The company was incorporated in 1956 and is based in Mumbai, India.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~-5% a year growth, below the ~10% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 8 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 12), though that is a short history to judge by.
Trades at PE 8 vs a quality-and-growth-justified 14 for this sector; cheaper than peers of similar quality.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 17% a year while PE moved 10 → 8.
